enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Snore. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Lie still. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and getting out of bed
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Blink. Stretch arms. Sit up. Swing legs over edge of bed. Place feet on floor. Stand up. Take a step. Walk to bedroom door. Open door. Walk out of bedroom.
Turn on bathroom light. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face with water. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off light.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk, eggs, bread. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into pan. Turn on stove. Stir eggs. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Pick up plate. Place eggs and toast on plate. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Put plate in sink. Turn off stove. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Pick out shirt. Pick out pants. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Check bag contents. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Walk to bedroom door. Open door. Walk out.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Stand up. Pull cord. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurse station. Pick up patient chart. Review chart. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient: 'Hello, how are you feeling?' Check patient's vitals. Measure blood pressure. Record readings. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Walk to next patient room. Repeat.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Pick up tray. Return tray. Walk to restroom. Use restroom. Wash hands. Walk back to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter patient room. Check patient's condition. Adjust IV drip. Administer medication. Update patient chart. Talk to patient's family. Walk to nurse station. Answer phone. Take message. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Return to nurse station. Review lab results. Consult with doctor. Walk to next patient room.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Look out window. Stand up. Pull cord. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, chicken. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir. Place food on plate. Eat dinner. Drink water. Put plate in sink. Turn off stove. Turn off light.

Enter living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Walk back. Sit down. Watch TV.
Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open browser. Check email. Type email. Send email. Open document. Edit document. Save document. Open game. Play game. Close game. Shut down computer. Stand up.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Lather body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Apply shampoo. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clothes. Turn off light.
Enter bedroom. Turn on lamp. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Walk to bathroom. Brush teeth. Walk back to bedroom. Turn off lamp. Pull back blanket. Lie down. Adjust pillow. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Lie still. Breathe deeply. Remain asleep.
